hazards.reason: Backfilling trg_order_enqueue_order_shipped_insert enqueues a message for every row of order that meets its conditions while the new trigger's lock blocks writes to order; for a large table, add the trigger without backfill and run stack queue backfill.
hazards.subject: trigger/order/trg_order_enqueue_order_shipped_insert

statements:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_order_enqueue_order_shipped_insert" AFTER INSERT ON "order" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."note" IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "order_shipped_queue" ("order_id", "note") VALUES (NEW."id", NEW."note")
    ON CONFLICT (order_id) WHERE state = 'ready' DO UPDATE SET note = excluded.note, due_at = excluded.due_at, attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now');
END

INSERT INTO "order_shipped_queue" ("order_id", "note")
SELECT src."id", src."note"
FROM "order" AS src
WHERE src."note" IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (order_id) WHERE state = 'ready' DO UPDATE SET note = excluded.note, due_at = excluded.due_at, attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_order_enqueue_order_shipped_update" AFTER UPDATE ON "order" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (OLD."note" IS NOT NEW."note") AND NEW."note" IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "order_shipped_queue" ("order_id", "note") VALUES (NEW."id", NEW."note")
    ON CONFLICT (order_id) WHERE state = 'ready' DO UPDATE SET note = excluded.note, due_at = excluded.due_at, attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now');
END
